text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted a girl sitting on a 
bench, crafting amigurumi out of beads.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oof, oof... Getting the kitty's pattern 
right is tricky, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whew, time for a break.
choice_data_list: It's amazing that you made it by hand.
It's amazing that you made it by hand.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's still very much a work in progress, 
though. Fufu, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A friend of mine has a birthday coming up, 
you see. I'm making her pet cat— 
Daifuku-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec, okay? I'll show you 
Daifuku-chan right now……

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, isn't it such a cute, round, and 
chubby kitty?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I sure hope it turned out looking like the 
real thing.
choice_data_list: You look just like them! A spitting image!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so? Getting praised that 
much makes an old lady blush, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Thanks to you, I've got my 
motivation back again.
choice_data_list:
Guts, guts, and more guts! I'm cheering 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Thanks to you, I've got my 
motivation back again.
choice_data_list:
Guts, guts, and more guts! I'm cheering 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A birthday is a special day that only 
comes once a year. I want to make sure 
it's a wonderful memory for her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As a friend, I just want to do whatever I 
can to help.
choice_data_list: I'm sure it'll make a wonderful present.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'd be very happy if she felt that 
way too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Nooow then, let's turn you into the most 
adorable little Daifuku-chan ever~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Wonder Acute continued 
working without losing her concentration 
for a single second.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, thank you for the support. It truly 
warms my heart, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
See how delicate and fine Daifuku-chan's 
stripes are? I want to make sure I capture 
that perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's a very special gift, after all. I 
need to pour everything I have into it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Step by step, bit by bit. Do that, and 
it'll turn out just right, you'll see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A tireless, hardworking soul――for a 
moment, I felt like I caught a glimpse of 
a whole new side to the laid-back girl.
